context:
Goal: the past-transit page flags late mail at the right time.
Problem: this only matters if item 11 keeps the Sorting Frame's past-transit page. The mockups assumed 10 days. The app already shows an amber warning at 14 days.
Meanwhile: manifest-duo waits for item 11.

options.how: Past transit starts where the amber flag starts.
options.label: Reuse 14 days
options.lose: Late mail shows 4 days later than the mockup.

options.how: A new, earlier threshold for the Duo page.
options.label: Use 10 days
options.lose: Two different 'late' meanings in one app.

ref: Duo concepts PR #139 (Sorting Frame's past-transit page); the existing 14-day amber flag
title: Duo: when is mail 'past usual transit'?
